items.title: Why AI coding agents feel powerful at first, then become harder to control
items.raw_excerpt:
I’ve been thinking a lot about why AI coding agents feel great in the beginning, but become frustrating as projects grow. At small scale, prompting works. As the codebase grows, things start to drift:
- constraints leak into prompts
- commands get longer
- behavior becomes inconsistent
- “helpful” changes appear outside the intended scope Lately, I’ve been mapping common agent concepts (rules, commands, skills, sub-agents, MCP, hooks) not as features, but as control layers in an execution loop. Very roughly:
- rules constrain decisions
- commands trigger execution
- skills encode repeatable methodology
- sub-agents limit responsibility
- MCP enables observation
- hooks enforce guarantees My hypothesis is that many frustrations come from mixing these layers. For example, encoding constraint

items.title: I built COON an code compressor that saves 30-70% on AI API costs

# COON: Compress Your Code, Cut AI Costs by 70% *Show HN: I built a code compressor that saves 30-70% on AI API costs* I'm tired of paying $100s/month for AI API calls when half the tokens are just whitespace and boilerplate. So I built COON - a tool that compresses code before sending it to LLMs. *The problem:* A simple Flutter login screen uses 150 tokens. Multiply that by thousands of API calls and you're burning money. *The solution:* COON compresses that same code to 45 tokens (70% reduction). Same code, 70% cheaper. *Example:* Before (150 tokens):
```dart
class LoginScreen extends StatelessWidget { final TextEditingController emailController = TextEditingController(); // ... more boilerplate
}
``` After (45 tokens):
```
c:LoginScreen;f:emailController=X;m:b S{a:B{t:T"Login"}...
``` *

items.title: 独家丨小鹏副总裁、汽车互联网中心负责人魏斌休假
items.raw_excerpt: 继李力耘因身体原因暂离一线、刘先明接任自动驾驶中心负责人后，雷峰网获悉，小鹏副总裁、互联网中心负责人魏斌目前处于休假状态。 魏斌曾任高德地图产品总监，负责导航与地图产品规划。2021年底加入小鹏汽车，主导智能座舱的研发与落地。 加入小鹏汽车以来，魏斌主要负责汽车互联网中心，涵盖智能座舱、车载软件平台及相关AI能力建设。在其任内，小鹏逐步推动座舱系统从以功能为导向的“应用堆叠”，转向以算力、操作系统与模型能力为核心的底层架构升级。XPILOT 与座舱系统在底层平台上的协同，也在这一阶段被反复强调。 一位内部人士告诉雷峰网，在过去两年中，小鹏智能座舱的研发节奏明显加快，围绕高算力平台、统一软件架构以及持续 OTA 的能力建设，互联网中心承担了大量基础性工作。这一阶段的目标，并非单一产品体验优化，而是为后续AI能力在车端的长期演进打基础。 从组织层面看，魏斌所负责的互联网中心，与自动驾驶中心、整车软件平台之间存在高度协同关系。随着小鹏近年来不断强调“AI 汽车”定位，智能座舱逐渐从传统意义上的人机交互系统，演变为车端AI能力的重要载体，其战略权重也随之提升。 此前，自动驾驶负责人李力耘因身体原因暂离一线，由刘先明接任相关职务。 多位业内人士认为，这既与高强度研发周期下的个人状态有关，也反映出小鹏正处在新一轮技术与组织重构的关键阶段。 在2024年以来的多次公开表态中，小鹏汽车反复强调，将进一步聚焦核心技术、提升组织效率，并推动智能驾驶、智能座舱与整车平台的深度融合。（雷峰网）

excerpt_i18n.en: Following Li Liyun's temporary leave from the front line due to health reasons and Liu Xianming's succession as head of the autonomous driving center, Leiphone has learned that Wei Bin, vice president of Xpeng and head of the internet center, is currently on leave. Wei Bin previously served as product director at Amap, responsible for navigation and map product planning. He joined Xpeng Motors at the end of 2021, leading the research, development, and implementation of the smart cockpit. Since joining Xpeng, Wei Bin has primarily overseen the automotive internet center, covering the smart cockpit, in-vehicle software platform, and related AI capability development. Under his tenure, Xpeng gradually shifted the cockpit system from a function-oriented "application stacking" approach to an underlying architecture upgrade centered on computing power, operating systems, and model capabilities. The synergy between XPILOT and the cockpit system at the underlying platform level was also repeatedly emphasized during this period. An insider told Leiphone that over the past two years, the development pace of Xpeng's smart cockpit has significantly accelerated, with the internet center undertaking substantial foundational work around high-computing platforms, unified software architecture, and continuous OTA capability development. The goal during this phase was not merely optimizing individual product experiences but laying the groundwork for the long-term evolution of AI capabilities in vehicles. From an organizational perspective, the internet center led by Wei Bin maintains a high degree of collaboration with the autonomous driving center and the vehicle software platform. As Xpeng has increasingly emphasized its positioning as an "AI car" in recent years, the smart cockpit has evolved from a traditional human-machine interaction system into a crucial carrier for AI capabilities in vehicles, with its strategic importance rising accordingly. Previously, Li Liyun, head of autonomous driving, stepped down due to health reasons.
excerpt_i18n.es: Tras la salida temporal de Li Liyun de primera línea por motivos de salud y la sucesión de Liu Xianming como responsable del Centro de Conducción Autónoma, Leiphone ha sabido que Wei Bin, vicepresidente de Xpeng y director del Centro de Internet, se encuentra actualmente de vacaciones. Wei Bin fue anteriormente director de producto de Amap, encargado de la planificación de productos de navegación y mapas. Se unió a Xpeng Motors a finales de 2021, liderando el desarrollo e implementación del habitáculo inteligente. Desde su incorporación a Xpeng Motors, Wei Bin ha estado principalmente a cargo del Centro de Internet del Automóvil, abarcando el habitáculo inteligente, la plataforma de software del vehículo y la construcción de capacidades de IA relacionadas. Durante su mandato, Xpeng ha impulsado gradualmente la transición del sistema del habitáculo de una "acumulación de aplicaciones" orientada a funciones a una actualización de la arquitectura subyacente centrada en la potencia de cálculo, el sistema operativo y las capacidades del modelo. items.title: AI To B：巨头争霸遇卡点，金山办公给出「数据」新解法
items.raw_excerpt: 当前，企业AI应用的卡点在哪？这是大模型从技术跑分进入价值落地后，千行百业最关心的问题。 一个难以忽视的现实是，近三年来，尽管大模型能力飞速发展、算力价格持续下降，但技术层面的进步并未自动转化为企业AI生产力的实质性突破。 另一方面，对企业来说，头部模型的快速迭代让企业在模型侧作出的努力“保鲜期”极短，越来越多的企业选择外部采购模型，这时企业自身在AI时代的护城河又在哪里？ 这两个问题都指向了同一本质： 在AGI下半场，企业数据治理的必要性、重要性与紧迫性。 1月27日，金山办公2026年首场WPS 365 AI协同办公峰会在上海举行，以“从全域知识到企业大脑——高质量数据的应用治理”为主题，通过一系列企业落地案例，对上述两大行业痛点做出了探讨、回应。 从RAG到KAG，让大模型真正“掌握”企业知识 大会开场，长期深耕相关领域的中金公司研究部执行总经理、计算机行业首席分析师于钟海，结合此前的一系列调研结果指出：头部模型的快速迭代让企业在模型侧的努力“保鲜期”极短，这种情况下，数据作为 AI 时代的企业底盘，将是企业唯一可持续的 AI 护城河。 但企业实际落地 AI 应用时，总会遇到不少痛点，比如复杂文档解析、知识冲突、企业黑话、问答相关性弱等，而这些问题的背后，是企业在数据治理和高效利用上的短板。 为了解决这些行业痛点，为企业数据赋能，金山办公在本次大会上提出了 知识增强生成 （Knowledge-Augmented Generation）的新范式。与传统的检索增强生成（Retrieval-Augmented Generation）仅让大模型“看到”文档不同，KAG架构系统性融合多模态、多结构的知识资产，使AI能够真正“掌握”企业知识的内在逻辑与关联。 金山办公助理总裁朱熠锷提出，眼下，企业AI应用正加速从“以模型为中心”转向“以数据为中心”，数据质量成为决定企业AI应用效

This is the most pressing question for all industries as large models transition from technical benchmarks to practical value delivery. excerpt_i18n.es: Actualmente, ¿cuál es el punto crítico en la aplicación de la IA empresarial? Esta es la pregunta que más preocupa a todos los sectores tras la transición de los modelos de gran tamaño desde las pruebas técnicas hacia la implementación de valor. Una realidad ineludible es que, en los últimos tres años, a pesar del rápido desarrollo de las capacidades de los modelos de gran tamaño y la continua disminución del precio de la computación, los avances tecnológicos no se han traducido automáticamente en un avance sustancial de la productividad de la IA empresarial. Por otro lado, para las empresas, la rápida iteración de los modelos líderes hace que los esfuerzos realizados en el lado del modelo tengan una "vida útil" extremadamente corta. Cada vez más empresas optan por adquirir modelos externamente, lo que plantea la pregunta: ¿dónde está la ventaja competitiva de las empresas en la era de la IA? Ambos problemas apuntan a la misma esencia: en la segunda mitad de la AGI, la gobernanza de datos empresariales es imprescindible.

As the Spring Festival approaches, the annual "red envelope battle" arrives as expected. Unlike previous years, this year's main players have shifted from mobile payments to AI assistants. On January 25, Tencent and Baidu announced their entry: Tencent's "Yuanbao" declared it would distribute 10 billion yuan in cash red envelopes, while Baidu's "Wenxin" launched a 5 billion yuan red envelope campaign. Although ByteDance has not announced any red envelope plans, its subsidiary Volcano Engine has become the exclusive AI cloud partner for the 2026 CCTV Spring Festival Gala. On January 29, media reports indicated that Alibaba's Qianwen APP will send red envelope benefits to users during the Spring Festival. The core goal of this subsidy war initiated by tech giants is to compete for the entry point of next-generation AI interaction, channeling user traffic into their respective AI ecosystems.

Facing the competition for AI entry points, internet giants have adopted distinctly different strategies. Baidu has chosen the path of "seamless migration." Unlike AI assistants like Doubao, Qianwen, and Yuanbao, which require separate app downloads, Wenxin is deeply embedded within the Baidu APP, which boasts 700 million monthly active users. Leveraging the national-level search scenario, users can naturally access AI functions while searching or browsing information without needing to download additional apps. Currently, Wenxin Assistant has surpassed 200 million monthly active users. For this Spring Festival red envelope campaign, Baidu's strategy is also centered on promoting Wenxin Assistant through the Baidu APP, aiming to smoothly convert traditional search users into AI users and solidify its position as a "search + AI" super entry point.

El 25 de enero, Tencent y Baidu anunciaron su entrada en escena: "Yuanbao" de Tencent declaró que distribuirá 1.000 millones de yuanes en efectivo en sobres rojos, mientras que "Wenxin" de Baidu lanzó una campaña de 500 millones de yuanes. Aunque ByteDance no ha revelado planes de sobres rojos, su motor Volcano se ha convertido en el socio exclusivo de nube de IA para la Gala de la CCTV de 2026. El 29 de enero, informes de medios mostraron que la aplicación "Qianwen" de Alibaba enviará beneficios de sobres rojos a los usuarios durante las festividades. Esta guerra de subsidios iniciada por los gigantes tiene como objetivo central competir por la entrada a la próxima generación de interacción con IA, captando usuarios.

excerpt_i18n.en: The AI wave is here, where are my opportunities? How can I make money? Over the past year and a half, these have been the most pressing questions weighing on every partner within the Tencent Cloud ecosystem. Their attention has unanimously turned to Yang Chen, the newly appointed head of Tencent Cloud's Industry Ecosystem Cooperation Department in May 2024.
